title: Efficacy of rituximab for remission maintenance in patients with primary angiitis of the central nervous system: an open-label, randomized, controlled trial comparing systematic rituximab infusions and azathioprine - MAINRIPAC
official: Efficacy of rituximab for remission maintenance in patients with primary angiitis of the central nervous system: an open-label, randomized, controlled trial comparing systematic rituximab infusions and azathioprine - MAINRIPAC
summary: Main objective: To determine the superiority of rituximab over azathioprine for maintenance therapy in patients with primary angiitis of central nervous system
conditions: Patients with primary angiitis of the central nervous system

interventions.name: Ruxience 500 mg concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient aged of 18 years or older
2. Patients who have documented PACNS diagnosis
3. Diagnosis of PACNS validated by the study committee
4. Patients in remission after induction therapy
5. Use of an effective method of contraception for female participants of childbearing age
6. Patient able to give written informed consent prior to participation in the study
7. Affiliation with a mode of social security
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients with other vasculitis
2. Patients with severe cardiac failure
3. Patients with acute or chronic active infections
4. Patients with active or recent cancer (< 5 years)
5. Pregnant women and lactation
6. Patients with hypersensitivity to a monoclonal antibody or biologic agent
7. Patients suspected not to be observant to the proposed treatments
8. Patients unable to give written informed consent prior to participation in the study
9. Patients under guardianship, conservatorship, or subject to a court-ordered restraint
sponsor: Groupe Hospitalier Universitaire Paris Psychiatrie Et Neuroscience
